statement_nl: For each j in V(s), let m_left = j-1 and m_right = n-j. The factor left_count(j) is the count of a sign pattern of size m_left, and right_count(j) is the count of a sign pattern of size m_right. If one of these sizes is 0 or 1, A3 identifies its count with E_0 or E_1. If one of these sizes is at least 2, the induction hypothesis says that every sign pattern of that size has count at most the alternating maximum for that size, namely E_{m_left} or E_{m_right}. Therefore every summand in A2 is at most w_j := binomial(n-1,j-1) E_{j-1} E_{n-j}.
